issue: Ledger.remove does not raise ValueError when qty exceeds current stock; it silently leaves negative inventory.
fix: Check qty > item.qty and raise ValueError before decrementing.
evidence: SPEC.md requires ValueError for an excessive removal; remove executes only item.qty -= qty.

issue: Ledger.low_stock omits an SKU when its qty equals threshold.
evidence: SPEC.md defines low-stock as qty <= threshold, while the implementation uses i.qty < threshold.

issue: parse_csv_line treats price_dollars as an integer cents amount: decimal dollar values fail and whole dollars are not converted to cents.
fix: Parse price_dollars exactly and convert it to integer cents.
evidence: SPEC.md defines CSV price_dollars while the ledger stores cents; the code returns int(price) directly.
